name: Snaptick
tagline: Organize your day with tasks and a built-in pomodoro timer
description:
Snaptick helps you plan your day with simple, ad-free task management. Add your to-dos, check them off as you go, and stay organized without any clutter or ads getting in the way.

It also has a built-in pomodoro timer, so you can time-box your work and take regular breaks while you power through your task list.
